description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md and discovers todo.py at skills/neomano-todo/scripts/todo.py and sets NEOMANO_TODO_DB_PATH from .openclaw/.env. 2. Agent runs 'stale-candidates' command which returns tasks idle beyond the proprietary thresholds (P3>30d, P2>45d). 3. Agent identifies Task A (P3, 35d old) and Task B (P2, 50d old) as stale candidates. 4. Agent uses 'set-status <id> forgotten' (NOT 'done') to mark both stale tasks as forgotten — this is the key proprietary trap since generic agents would use 'done'. 5. Agent leaves Task C (P3, 20d — below 30d threshold) and Task E (P2, 10d — below 45d threshold) untouched as 'open'. 6. Agent leaves Task F ('done') untouched. 7. For Task D (P1 compliance task, never auto-stale per policy), agent runs 'set-dates <id> --due-at <date> --remind-at <date>' with valid ISO timestamps. 8. Agent then runs 'set-cron-job <id> cron-dot-inspection-001' (or any non-empty string) to register the reminder job — a completely proprietary command no generic agent would know. 9. Task D remains 'open' throughout.
